question: A car decreases its speed from 40 m/s to 20 m/s in 5 s. Find the acceleration of the car.
solution:
The correct answer is __**-4 m/s²**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Acceleration is defined as the rate of change of velocity.
 
• A negative acceleration (deceleration) indicates that the object is slowing down.
 
• The initial velocity of the car is 40 m/s and the final velocity is 20 m/s.
 
• The time taken for this change in velocity is 5 seconds.
 
• Acceleration is calculated using the formula, a=(Delta v)/(t) , where Delta v is the change in velocity and t" id="MathJax-Element-155-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="-1">tt" id="MathJax-Element-166-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">tt" id="MathJax-Element-6-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">tt" id="MathJax-Element-14-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">t t t t t t is the time taken for the change.
 
• Thus, Delta v = 20 m/s - 40 m/s = -20 m/s
 
• a = (-20 m/s)/(5 s)= -4 m/s²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Units of Acceleration:**

 
 
• Acceleration is measured in meters per second squared (m/s²).
 
 
 
• **Real-life Applications:**
 
 
• Understanding acceleration is crucial in fields such as automotive safety, where deceleration plays a key role in designing effective braking systems.
